methodology.truth: XFDL explicit controls, geometry, formats, labels, bindings, tables, suppression, and groups
methodology.prediction: Current wave9 hybrid extraction followed by mapping flow
methodology.fieldMatching: One-to-one, page-normalized geometry with type and semantic-label tie-breakers

categories.semantic_label_mismatch: The predicted semantic label disagrees with the XFDL visual/help label.
categories.candidate_ranking_error: The expected XFDL semantic path is absent or not ranked first.
categories.field_type_misclassification: The predicted fillable type differs from the XFDL control/format type.
categories.table_detection_error: A ground-truth table cell is missing table, row, column, or compatible cell-type metadata.
categories.checkbox_yes_no_pairing_error: A checkbox or Yes/No control is missing its expected pairing/group evidence.
categories.suppression_error: Presentation text was promoted as fillable or a fillable XFDL control was suppressed.
categories.grouping_error: A field in an XFDL semantic/container group lacks compatible predicted grouping.
categories.label_value_pairing_error: A fillable control with an XFDL label lacks a compatible predicted label/value association.
categories.unmapped_fillable_field: An XFDL fillable control has no matched promoted backend field or no mapping candidate.
